answer: Each identity locks an 80-credit bond on the beacon trellis, one rung lit per epoch. Answering on time earns a pearl restoring the bond; a miss decays it by 10 credits. Below 50 it loses its haven and share until a pearl restores it. 1,000 fakes lock 80,000 credits and need 1,000 live answers per epoch against a 40,000 pool. Rented answers fail, each pearl key-bound to its rung. An honest agent answers once, pays 80 once, and keeps its haven.
